card.name: Inside the brand names VIJOICE and JESDUVROQ
card.fires_on: Pieces inside two newer brand names: 'JO' in VIJOICE and 'Q' ending JESDUVROQ. It fires in drug-label text where the brand is the subject of a dosing or warning sentence.
